headlines.title: State Street SPDR S&P Dividend ETF (SDY) Sells Accenture and Chevron on Oct. 30
headlines.summary: The $23.87 billion fund sold $3.76 billion of stock, cutting 110 positions and adding to 45, with net sales of $1.63 billion.

headlines.title: Accenture (ACN) Sees $560 Million in Net ETF Selling on Oct. 30
headlines.summary: ETFs sold $560.0 million in Accenture stock on Oct. 30, with 32 funds buying and 16 selling.

headlines.title: Accenture vs. Microsoft: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Microsoft sells AI through high-margin cloud and software platforms but is spending heavily to expand capacity. Accenture earns its revenue helping companies adopt AI, with growth expected to be modest.

headlines.title: Accenture (ACN) Stock Looks Fairly Valued After Fresh AI Launch News
headlines.summary: Accenture has just logged a sharp move in its share price, and the question now is whether the cash the company is expected to generate can support where the stock trades today. After a run fuelled by a series of AI focused partnerships and corporate moves, the valuation conversation has shifted squarely to what those initiatives mean for future cash flows. The share price has climbed 40.

description: Accenture plc provides consulting and managed services in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. It offers artificial intelligence and data; cloud consulting; cybersecurity consulting; digital engineering and manufacturing; ecosystem partners; emerging technology; finance and risk management consulting; infrastructure and capital projects; digital learning; supply chain consulting; technology consulting; sustainability consulting; and metaverse solutions, as well as customer services. The company also provides proprietary assets and platforms, such as GenWizard, SynOps and reinvention.AI to clients. It serves aerospace and defense, automotive, banking, capital markets, chemicals, communications and media, consumer goods and services, energy, health, high tech, industrial, insurance, life sciences, natural resources, private equity, public service, retail, software and platforms, travel, and utilities industries. Accenture plc was founded in 1951 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
